name: Design and Construction of the MicroBooNE Detector

summary.plain: The engineering paper describing how the 170-tonne MicroBooNE liquid-argon detector was designed and built.
summary.technical: JINST 12 (2017) P02017 (arXiv:1612.05824): design and construction of the MicroBooNE single-phase LArTPC, 170 t total / 90 t active argon mass, 2.6 m maximum drift, 8256 sense wires on three planes, 470 m from the BNB target.
